brief: For North Macedonia, the international-monitor layer splits cleanly in two: rating agencies and IFIs (Fitch, Moody's, IMF Article IV, World Bank/FSAP, EBRD, EC enlargement reports, EBA, BIS) give authoritative but slow, institution-level commentary on supervisory capacity, fit-and-proper regimes and board governance — they almost never name an individual MK bank executive — while the wire/trade layer (SeeNews above all, plus bne IntelliNews, S&P Global MI and The Banker) is where actual named appointments surface in English, usually paywalled but with free headline metadata and a usable Reuters/SEE News syndication mirror on TradingView. Local-language search proved essential and outperformed the English seeds: bankarstvo.mk, biznisvesti.mk and nezavisen.mk report supervisory-board session numbers, dates, and crucially predecessor-successor pairs that the English wires omit, and the Службен весник plus NBRNM's 'Одлука за издавање согласности' define the legal paper trail every appointment must leave. The archive leg of the cell is intact in principle but unproven in practice here: the Wayback CDX API was unreachable from this environment (a tooling restriction, not a dead source), so no archived 'Управен и Надзорен одбор' pages could be enumerated — this should be the first thing the collection pipeline retries. Two seed-named outlets, Balkan Insight and Emerging Europe, and Finextra's regional desk showed no MK banking-personnel coverage at all, and no international source covers rank-and-file hiring, leaving the 'jobs/hiring' topics of this run essentially uncovered by this cell.
